## Demo for GitHub Class

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

## Let's first check how many penguins in each species.

```{r}
penguins |>
  count(species)
```

## Let's also add a plot.

```{r}
penguins |>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = species, y = body_mass_g, fill = species)) +
  geom_boxplot()+
  labs(title = "penguin body mass in grams by species")
```
